concept.reason: Real whole-specimen photo and published dorsal/ventral species reconstruction are adequate.

scope: Complete Lower Devonian Weinbergina opitzi, outline and scale anchored to MB.A.1987, with same-species published limb reconstruction. Not an isolated shield or fossil slab.

scientific_limits.en: Dimensions are estimates from the20mm bar in MB.A.1987 photograph, not caliper measurements. Living convexity, pose and color are inferred. Six walking pairs are supported; total blade-foot count is uncertain, six is a published reconstruction, not six pristine preserved pairs.
scientific_limits.zh: 尺度按MB.A.1987照片20毫米标尺估计，并非卡尺实测。活体隆起、姿势和颜色为推断。六对步足有据，腹部板状附肢总数不确定；六组属于文献复原，不是六组完整保存。

scale.uncertainty: Approximately15percent on image dimensions, with oblique fossil deformation; no precision claim. Height not measured in flattened specimen.

anatomy: Broad rounded anterior shield with thin edge, vaulted rather than flat modern horseshoe rim. Subtle ophthalmic/cardial relief; eye evidence uncertain, no conspicuous invented compound eyes.

Ten free opisthosomal segments with blunt extended lateral points and modest axial/pleural nodes; rear three near-equal width form less distinct postabdomen. Needle-like tapering triangular-section telson.
One cheliceral pair plus six similarly constructed walking-leg pairs. No Offacolus/Dibasterium branched brush exopods. Walking feet end in pointed claw/spurs, not six large pincer pairs.

Ventral transverse blade-feet with short marginal teeth/lamellar suggestion; use conservative six-group published restoration, mark number inference. At least3confirmed in2005 specimen;1981 could identify4inone specimen, neither proves complete6.
restoration_boundaries: Primary atlas photograph MB.A.1987 supplies silhouette/20mm scale;1981 diagrams synthesize multiple same-species specimens and disclose interpretive reconstruction. Do not claim diagram or limb measurement is MB.A.1987 direct anatomy.
1981 Fig1a is Limuloides, not Weinbergina; Fig1b other-taxon comparisons not copied. Fig3 is species reconstruction and separately labeled as such. AtlasFig4onlyA is Weinbergina.
Do not reproduce rock,cracks,pyritization,broken taphonomic limb arrangement or reference pixels. Muted color neutral standing pose original artistic choices.
quality_gates: Whole animal with six walkingpairs plus chelicerae, not modern fivewalkingpairs.
Ten free tergites, no fused thoracetron or eleven copied Dibasterium segments.
Conservative uncertain ventral plate count is disclosed, not described as entirely preserved.
Default four views only; perspective/side must show leg silhouette. Hidden anatomy can be checked directly without default extra render.
